description: This Java class, CsrfDefenseStrategy, implements CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) protection logic for the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to generate CSRF tokens, determine request subfolder limits for token lookup, modify security tokens, decide whether to retain tokens after use, and handle invalid tokens.

classes.name: CsrfDefenseStrategy
classes.description: Implements CSRF defense strategies, including token generation and validation, for secure web requests within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a secure random CSRF token using a predefined character set and cryptographic PRNG.

methods.name: maxSubFolderInRequestUrlForTokenMapLookup
methods.description: Determines maximum subfolder depth for token map lookup based on request URI starting with 'entity/'.

methods.name: modifySecurityCsrfToken
methods.description: Decides whether to modify or check CSRF tokens based on the request URI and token value.

methods.name: keepTokenAfterUse
methods.description: Determines whether to keep CSRF token after use, allowing browser navigation back/forward.

methods.name: invalidTokenResponse
methods.description: Handles invalid or missing CSRF tokens by setting an error message and throwing an exception.
